task_instance: Code one custdev discovery interview transcript into a verbatim-grounded mapping: route the intake to a lens, number the transcript lines, extract claims/nuggets, and verify every quote against the source so each conclusion is grounded in an exact verbatim quote (the skill's core deliverable).
blocker_detail: The skill's entire workflow is executed by bundled stdlib Python scripts that must be run (route.py to pick the lens, number_lines.py to number/flag lines, verify_quotes.py to mechanically confirm each quote is verbatim in the source, consensus.py for multi-run reliability, score_insights.py and extract_nuggets.py for synthesis). The skill's defining property is that grounding is 'checked by a script, not by eye', so the verified deliverable cannot exist without executing these scripts. This office-assistant runtime grants only text read/write/edit and web; it cannot run code, scripts, or shell commands, so no pipeline step can be executed. Doing the coding/verification by hand would (a) require writing a replacement for the bundled scripts, which the run rules forbid, and (b) violate the skill's own anti-pattern of verifying by eye, so it would not be the actual deliverable.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: workflow steps 1-3 and the Scripts section require running route.py, number_lines.py, verify_quotes.py, check_support.py, consensus.py, score_insights.py, extract_nuggets.py ('All 15 are stdlib-only Python with --help/--sample/--output'). Verified via Glob that all 15 scripts plus references and templates are present in the skill folder, so this is not a missing-skill-file case; the blocker is purely the inability to execute them. Created a realistic sample input at <work>/transcript.txt (an 8-turn customer-discovery interview) to run the pipeline on. The first required step (python3 scripts/route.py --goal discovery --respondent customer) and every subsequent verification step need code execution, which the runtime does not provide and the no-Bash/no-code rule prohibits. No verified mapping deliverable was produced.
